mapper.select: SELECT u.*, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.id WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT p.* FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.role_id = rp.role_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.sort
